method.policy: Paired same seed/player policy. First extraction manual65/bourbon; later explicitly renewed one-shot usual. Bootstrap up to2casks with6month releases untilmonth36, then4casks rotating6/12/24month targets by stable caskID. Samebrand, standard shelf price. All retailer offers accepted, no-store control retains relations but never delivers. Store arm begins optional deliveries at month48 (allowing real retail evidence to accumulate), waits at least one monthly boundary after bottling so new destination offers can see qualifying stock, keeps24month releases on the retail shelf until the first department relationship is offered (no stock reservation; retail continues), then prioritizes department, supermarket, individual; delivers greatest valid quantity from oldest eligible stocked product. Existing wholesale offers declined to isolate finished-bottle destinations. No cash/age/stock/offer injection.
method.limitations: A deterministic stock-allocation policy, not optimized play or a human fun verdict. Highest-price-first deliberately tests department preference;5bottle cap and24month eligibility limit its share. Arms may diverge in production when cash differs; flows and remaining inventory are reported, not liquidation profit. All original chemistry, aging, demand, reputation and costs unchanged.
